description: This is a Java source file defining the PhoneApplication class, which extends Application. It initializes a LocationDataManager with a LocationDbHelper and provides access to the data manager instance. The class serves as the application entry point for the Android wearable speed tracker app.

classes.name: PhoneApplication
classes.description: Represents the application class for the speed tracker wearable app, managing initialization of data components.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the database helper and data manager when the application starts.

methods.name: getDataManager
methods.description: Returns the instance of LocationDataManager used within the application.
